docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The folk tales of Assam as an old grandmother tells them, collected and retold in 1911 by Lakshminath Bezbaroa, the 'Sahityarathi' of Assamese literature.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Lakṣmīnāth Bezbaruā (Lakshminath Bezbaroa, 1864–1938), Burhī Āir Sādhu (1911), as transcribed on Assamese Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain. Modified: converted to this format.
